run.procedureSummary: 1. Charge in: add the cycle's feed to each stage; no rating cap. 2. Shunts: walk stages 1 to 6 in order; if charge > rating, set it to rating and add the excess to the next stage (stage 6 excess to ground), so an upstream dump is included when the next stage is checked. 3. Comparators: read the post-shunt charge; CLEAR -> ASSERTED if charge >= upper threshold, ASSERTED -> CLEAR if charge <= lower threshold, otherwise hold; log each flip. 4. Bleed: snapshot all six post-shunt charges and use the states just set in step 3; CLEAR stage loses floor(charge/4) to ground; ASSERTED stage loses floor(charge/2) to stage i-1 (stage 1's goes to ground); apply all moves at once; no rating check. 5. Breaker: sum the chain; if sum > 38, each stage becomes floor(charge/2) and (old sum - new sum) goes to ground, and the cycle is noted; at 38 or under, nothing.

openPoints.assumption: The states as updated by this cycle's comparator step (step 3 finishes chain-wide before step 4).
Bleed amounts are computed from the post-shunt charges (same values the comparators read), all taken before any move is applied.
Single pass 1 to 6; excess dumped into stage i+1 is counted before stage i+1 is checked; no second pass.
Strictly over 38 trips; cycle 5 ended at exactly 38 so it did not trip.
Ground receives the sum of per-stage remainders (old total minus sum of floor halves), not total/2.

openPoints.point: What counts in the ground tally
openPoints.assumption: All flows to ground: stage 6 shunt overflow, CLEAR quarter leaks, stage 1 ASSERTED return, and breaker halving losses.
Left as is after cycle 5 bleed (stage 2 at 10 > 8, stage 4 at 7 > 6), as the write-up allows.
